name: WeftMark
tagline: A little less blind trust. A little more light on the work.
description: When people and AI agents build together, speed is only half the story. WeftMark connects the purpose, changes, evidence and human judgment—so the next person can understand what happened.
status: Prototype · local evidence, review and handoff workflows implemented
motifCaption: The loom: separate threads, an inspectable story.

sv.title: WeftMark
sv.description: När människor och AI-agenter bygger tillsammans räcker det inte med fart. WeftMark håller samman syfte, ändringar, underlag och mänsklig granskning—så att nästa person kan förstå vad som hände.

sections.title: Förtroende som går att förklara
paragraphs: En snabb arbetare kan skriva mycket kod. Det svåra är att veta vad som fick ändras, vilket underlag som finns och vem som tog ställning till resultatet. WeftMark gör de frågorna synliga.

Verktyget är en prototyp, inte ett löfte om att AI alltid blir säker. Människors omdöme, ansvar och möjlighet att säga nej är fortfarande avgörande. RAGBAZ vill skapa verktyg för omtanke och ömsesidigt samarbete.

sections.title: Väven och lunden hör ihop
paragraphs: Sylvae kör portabla färdigheter och sparar körningarnas kvitton. WeftMark knyter dem till kodens historia och granskning. Nostoi granskar loggkedjor; Rebekah ger verktygen en gemensam, självhostad verkstad.
Läs den illustrerade artikeln Väven och lunden för en lättillgänglig introduktion. De engelska guiderna visar sedan ett första praktiskt steg.

highlights.label: Human judgment
highlights.title: A reviewer can see why
highlights.text: Keep implementation, verification, review and release distinct. A confident answer from an agent is not a substitute for evidence.

highlights.label: Shared understanding
highlights.title: A handoff, not archaeology
highlights.text: Purpose, scope and the next step survive a session. A colleague can continue without reconstructing an entire conversation.

highlights.label: Practical freedom
highlights.title: Workers can change
highlights.text: Open formats and replaceable adapters reduce dependence on one model vendor, agent harness or forge.

sections.title: The scarce thing is not keystrokes. It is justified confidence.
paragraphs: WeftMark is RAGBAZ’s engineering provenance and review layer for human–agent software teams. A Change Set binds a goal to the files and meanings a worker may change, its Git lineage, evidence, review and handoff.

This matters when several workers move quickly. Two agents may touch different files and still break the same assumption. Scope must describe meaning as well as text; a finished task must carry more than the worker’s own claim.

For a person reviewing the work, the benefit is psychological as well as technical: less pressure to accept a confident answer, and a clearer place to ask a careful question. That is a design intention, not a measured claim about mental health.

sections.title: Use it where responsibility needs to survive the worker.
paragraphs: A small software team can connect a bug fix to its tests and reviewer. A research group can preserve how a result was produced. A volunteer project can hand work between people without losing the original purpose.

The CLI and tablet/phone review surfaces project the local ledger. Git and the forge still own commit and publication facts; WeftMark does not turn a green card into proof that something was merged or released.
Frog remains the operational scheduler and lock coordinator during the migration. WeftMark complements that work; it does not silently override ownership or locks.

sections.title: Accountability is one way to practise care.
paragraphs: RAGBAZ’s aspiration is software in the service of life: loving kindness, mutual cooperation and room for people to think. Keeping an understandable record can make it easier to include the quieter reviewer, question a risky shortcut and leave a considerate handoff.

We take doubts about AI seriously—whether the concern is autonomous mistakes, deceptive behaviour, reckless deployment or people directing powerful systems toward harm. Evidence and review improve the conditions for accountable decisions; they do not solve alignment or existential risk on their own.

The economical promise is modest and concrete: fewer lost handoffs and less unnecessary reconstruction. The environmental intention is to avoid wasteful work, while measuring rather than assuming the resource costs of a particular workflow.

sections.title: Bring the receipts to the loom.
paragraphs: Sylvae can provide a run identity that WeftMark records as the evidence producer. Nostoi can verify compatible ledger chains and help retain an external checkpoint. Rebekah packages the runtime and an authenticated gateway.

If you choose Ephor, governance decisions enter through an explicit integration. Engineering readiness, governance policy and a cryptographic signature remain different judgments. An agent should not quietly approve its own sensitive action.

workflow.title: Start with purpose and permission
workflow.text: Write what the change is for, define its file and semantic scope, and inspect the current Frog assignment and locks before editing.

workflow.title: Let a worker do bounded work
workflow.text: Use a person or an agent suited to the task. Sylvae can run a portable skill and preserve the run identity.

workflow.title: Attach evidence to the actual work
workflow.text: Bind checks to the clean commit they verify. Keep failed, passed, unavailable and stale evidence distinguishable.

workflow.title: Review, hand over and release deliberately
workflow.text: A human review is a decision, not a page view. Record the next action and publication facts before treating the work as complete.

quickstart.title: Inspect a local repository first
quickstart.summary: Start with the source checkout and a Python virtual environment. Point WeftMark at a real Git repository with a valid HEAD.
quickstart.note: Read the working protocol before claiming or changing work. Registry publication is pending; install from source.

commands.label: Install from source
commands.code:
git clone https://github.com/tabenius/WeftMark.git
cd WeftMark
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install .

pages.title: A workflow with room for human judgment
pages.description: How to connect purpose, bounded agent work, evidence and review without pretending that a claim is proof.

sections.title: Begin before the first edit
paragraphs: Read the repository’s instructions, identify the task and inspect the actual assignment and locks. Write the intended outcome and the boundaries that must not change.
Create or reuse the matching WeftMark task and acquire the native claim from the real worktree at its exact base commit. A native claim does not substitute for a Frog lock.

sections.title: Make checking part of the work
paragraphs: Record the command, producer identity and clean commit behind each piece of evidence. If a check cannot run, record unavailable; do not infer a pass.
A Sylvae run can be correlated through its run ID. A Nostoi verification or signed checkpoint can support integrity claims, while human review remains a separate decision.

sections.title: Leave something another person can understand
paragraphs: Name the exact head, what was checked, any remaining uncertainty and the next action. Ask for review of the public or sensitive contract, not merely a screenshot of a green test.
Preserve publication and merge facts from Git and the forge. The goal is not to remove human responsibility but to make it possible to exercise that responsibility with better information.
